stances_toward.note: Adversary, the only mortal enemy on this card. JNIM's stated aim is to replace state authority with its own interpretation of Islamic law (CSIS), so the junta's existence is at stake, not only its territory. The fuel blockade of Bamako from September 2025 and the army's airstrikes in reply are the evidence of the war. No source uses the word adversary: this is our reading and the reason it is rare. Bond none.

relations_to.summary: JNIM announced a fuel blockade of Mali in September 2025, enforced on the Senegal-Mali route and around Bamako: trucks were burned on the route, and the army answered with airstrikes. Mirror of the SEN and FRA cards' sources for the blockade.
